summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 1-0 victory over Stafford Town at home, with a first-half goal from Tatters proving decisive. The Bach secured a clean sheet in a battling performance against a resilient visiting side to claim three points on opening day. Manager made several substitutions in the second half to control the match, including bringing on Jake Pollard, Max Williams, and Jordan Stafford as they managed the game to victory.
